title: adenanthera pavonina var. microsperma
intro: Adenanthera pavonina var. microsperma, commonly known as the small-seeded red bead tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Adenanthera pavonina var. microsperma include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
